page.heading: Canal des Deux Mers Photo Gallery
page.intro: Photos from two Canal des Deux Mers cycling tours along the Bordeaux-to-Sète route in France.
page.description: Photos from two Canal des Deux Mers cycling tours along the Bordeaux-to-Sète route, grouped by location from Créon to Sète.
page.cta: Interested in riding the Canal des Deux Mers with us? Join the waitlist for a future BikeTourFrance trip.
